name: agent-teamworks
description: Build a persistent project team in Codex with clear roles, communication, and handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Build a project team with durable roles and clear ownership.
interface.longDescription: Use when you need to build a team for a project. Establish the smallest useful roster, bind available agents, set up communication, and save team records in the project. Return when the team needs adjustment or handoff; everyday work continues through its coordinator.
defaultPrompt: 为这个项目构建一个 Agent 团队，明确角色、职责和协作方式。
调整这个项目现有的 Agent 团队，保留历史和未完成事项。
为现有团队完成 Agent 交接，恢复未完成的工作。
